The training crew reviewed an idea about carrier checks, and thank you for your detailed note. We understand that your complaint concerns a frustrating boarding experience for your companion animal and the concern that the handling of the carrier did not match the care you expected from Aurelia Skyways.

Please accept our apology for the distress this caused. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey, and our teams are expected to apply calm, careful checks so that pets, carriers, and fellow travelers are protected throughout the process. When a traveler raises a concern of this kind, the Companion Animal Travel Desk follows a stepwise review that begins with the service record, then confirms how the gate team applied the checklist, and then looks for any gap in communication or handling. If the review shows that a process was missed, we address it directly with the staff involved and reinforce the expected standard.

We also want to reassure you that the aim of carrier screening is not to delay travel, but to make sure the animal has a secure space, the latch is reliable, and the fit is appropriate for the cabin or hold arrangement that was booked. Even when the desk is busy, we expect staff to speak clearly, remain respectful, and keep the traveler informed before any action is taken. That standard applies whether the concern is about a pet such as Daisy or any other companion animal traveling with Aurelia Skyways.

Your note has been passed to the relevant supervisor for review, and the observations will be used in routine training so that future handling is steadier and more consistent. We appreciate that a smooth journey matters to you, and we regret that this one did not meet that standard. Thank you for bringing the matter to our attention and for giving us the chance to improve our service.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
